We have a task: extract SMILES string efficiently. We have experimental data: mass spec (m/z 276.0666 as base peak), carbon NMR (14 peaks), etc. Need to deduce structure.

We have simulated spectra for candidate SMILES "CCOC(=O)C1=CC(=O)OC2=CC(=C(C=C12)C(=O)C)O". That SMILES is validated true. Let's see its formula. Use get_formula.
